name: card
title: Card
description: A raised sheet whose parts follow the room the card is given.
use: One thing with a title, a description, optional media and actions, on an article, a section or a list item. The same markup works in a sidebar, a grid and a full-width column.

instead.when: The surface has no header, media or footer
It shows one figure and what it measures
It is a radio or checkbox option with an explanation

classes.name: card
classes.description: The raised sheet and size container; its parts are spaced by 1rem

classes.name: card-flat
classes.description: One contour and no shadow, for cards in a dense list or on a tray

classes.name: card-interactive
classes.description: A card that is one link or button: it lifts under the pointer and sinks when pressed. No other control goes inside it

classes.name: card-split
classes.description: Sets the media beside the content from 28rem of content width, and on top below that

classes.name: card-media
classes.description: An image or video at the top, 4px inside the card, 16 / 9 by default

classes.name: card-header
classes.description: The heading group: a title, a description and an optional action at the end

classes.name: card-description
classes.description: A muted line under the title, in the header

classes.name: card-action
classes.description: A control or a status at the end of the header; under 15rem of content it moves below the text

classes.name: card-footer
classes.description: Actions at the foot, aligned to the end with the main one last; under 15rem of content they stack at full width, the main one first

properties.name: --card-media-inset
properties.description: Space between the media and the card's edge

properties.name: --card-split
properties.description: Share of the width the media takes in a split card
